notes: Model M365, the Mi Electric Scooter.

gaps: Battery capacity: the manual gives 280 Wh and the paper 300 Wh, so Wh is left out.
Chip conflict: the paper's Figure 3 caption says BQ73960 while its text says BQ76930.
An LM5025 stepdown-converter entry is left out because the README marks it with (??) and the wiki lists other step-down parts.
method: The Dutch Mi Electric Scooter user manual names model M365 with FCC-ID 2ALS8-NS9633 and IC 22636-NS9633 on its certification page, and gives 36 V, 280 Wh, and a 250/500 W wheel motor.
The E-Trojans paper reverse-engineered the M365 BMS: an ST STM8L151K6 (BCTRL) and a TI BQ76930 (BMON).
The ninebot-docs wiki names the motor controller MCU as STM32F103C8T6 (U6); the casainho README also names it and lists three MT8006 gate drivers.

comps.spec: STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller (Cortex-M3, ST), listed as U6, the MCU of the motor controller (ESC).
Three MT8006 power MOSFET driver chips, as listed in the motor controller section of the README.
The motor controller is one of three main blocks in the M365: user interface board with Bluetooth, motor controller, and battery BMS.
Wheel motor (Wielmotor) rated 250 W nominal and 500 W max. The manual does not state the motor type.
BMON battery monitor IC: Texas Instruments BQ76930. The BCTRL configures it over I2C, reads cell voltages from it, and it stores thresholds that activate hardware protections.
Li-Ion INR cells in 10 series x 3 parallel (30 cells), 7.80 Ah on the M365. The pack is rated 42 V at 100% and 36 V at 0%.
Charger adapter: input 100-240 VAC, output 42 VDC at 1.7 A, charge time about 5 hours. The spec table also lists 71 W output for it.
ST STM8L151K6 microcontroller, the BCTRL battery controller. It runs the BMS firmware and talks to the BMON over I2C.
comps.loc: BMS board, on the opposite side from the BMON

comps.spec: Bluetooth Low Energy board (BTS) with its own system-on-chip. The paper does not name the chip.
comps.loc: BTS board, separate from the BMS and motor controller boards

comps.spec: Three Hall sensors (A, B, C), wired from the controller to the motor. Part type and maker not stated.
comps.loc: wired to the wheel motor; exact position not stated

comps.spec: ESC temperature NTC, read by the MCU on pin PA0 (ADC1). Part number not stated.
comps.loc: motor controller board; exact position not stated

comps.spec: Headlight (Koplamp). After the scooter is on, a press of the power button switches it on or off. LED or bulb type not stated.
comps.loc: labelled Koplamp in the product overview; position not stated in the text

comps.spec: Brake light (Remlicht) listed in the product overview. Type not stated.
comps.loc: position not stated in the overview text

comps.spec: Four battery-level lights (acculampjes) on the control panel. The bottom one blinks white in normal mode and green in eco mode. LED or bulb type not stated.
Power button on the control panel. A press turns the scooter on; holding it for 2 seconds turns it off.
Charging port. The adapter's plug connects to it, and the rubber flap is closed afterwards.
